name: za.co.regfarm/regfarm-mcp
title: River Estate Game Farm — Safari Pricing & Concierge MCP
description: Live South African hunting safari species pricing, lodge availability, and instant quote calculator.

tools.name: get_farm_overview
tools.description: Get a verified overview of River Estate Game Farm (REG Farm) including Walk-and-Stalk hunting philosophy, terrain, location (~90 min from O.R. Tambo International Airport), luxury lodging rates, featured packages, and vehicle policies.

tools.name: get_species_pricing
tools.description: Retrieve live D1-backed plains game species catalog, minimum trophy horn sizes, trophy/male/female fees in South African Rand (ZAR) and live USD estimates, plus Subject to Quote (SQ) statuses.

limit.description: Maximum number of species records to return (clamped between 1 and 20; defaults to 20).

tools.name: check_booking_availability
tools.description: Verify whether a requested arrival and departure date range is available on the live lodge calendar and validate reserve booking rules (including the 2-night minimum weekend stay for Friday to Sunday).

start_date.description: Arrival date in ISO YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g. "2026-09-11").

end_date.description: Departure date in ISO YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g. "2026-09-14"). Must be after start_date.

tools.name: calculate_safari_quote
tools.description: Calculate an itemized safari package quote in ZAR and live USD based on hunters, non-hunters, under-12 children, nights, catering tier, optional day hunt, extra 4x4 vehicle surcharges, and selected game animals.

hunters.description: Number of active hunters (1 to 20). Daily rate: R1,900/night catered or R900/night self-catered.

non_hunters.description: Number of adult non-hunting guests or observers (0 to 20). Daily rate: R1,500/night catered or R700/night self-catered.

under_12_guests.description: Optional number of children under 12 years old (0 to 20). Rate: R1,000/night catered or R500/night self-catered.

nights.description: Number of lodge nights (1 to 60; minimum 2 nights for stays touching Friday, Saturday, or Sunday).

catering.description: Catering tier: "catered" (meals, drinks & PH guide) or "self" (self-catered kitchen & boma braai).

day_hunt.description: Optional flag to quote a single-day walk-and-stalk Day Hunt (R2,500 including 1 vehicle, guide & tracker) instead of overnight lodging.

selected_animals.description: Optional list of up to 20 game animals planned for harvest.

items.description: A single species entry specifying animal name, harvest category, and quantity.

name.description: Species name as listed in the REG Farm catalog (e.g. "Kudu (45\"+)", "Impala", "Blue Wildebeest (27\"+)").

quantity.description: Number of animals of this species and tier to include in the safari quote (1 to 20).

tools.name: prepare_booking_inquiry
tools.description: Prepare a verified safari booking summary, live ZAR/USD cost breakdown, optional date availability check, and pre-filled human confirmation link to https://regfarm.co.za/#quote-builder without triggering automated messages.

non_hunters.description: Number of adult non-hunting guests (0 to 20).

under_12_guests.description: Optional number of children under 12 years old (0 to 20).

nights.description: Number of nights at the lodge (1 to 60).

start_date.description: Optional preferred arrival date in YYYY-MM-DD format for live calendar conflict verification.

end_date.description: Optional preferred departure date in YYYY-MM-DD format for live calendar conflict verification.

selected_animals.description: Optional list of up to 20 planned species for harvest.

items.description: A single species entry specifying animal name, harvest category, and quantity.

name.description: Species name as listed in the REG Farm catalog (e.g. "Kudu (45\"+)", "Impala", "Blue Wildebeest (27\"+)").

quantity.description: Number of animals of this species and tier to include in the safari quote (1 to 20).

notes.description: Optional special requests such as rifle rental, bow hunting, airport transfers, or dietary preferences.

tools.name: get_safari_rules_and_faq
tools.description: Retrieve verified information on ethical walk-and-stalk rules, recommended rifle calibers, SAPS 520 temporary firearm import permits, bow hunting draw weights, taxidermy dipping and export, lodging amenities, and packing lists.

topic.description: Specific FAQ category to retrieve, or "all" for the complete safari guide. Defaults to "all".
